name: sweep a line across the plane and test only neighbours in the active order at each event
mechanism: sort the segment endpoints as events; as a vertical line sweeps them, keep the segments it currently crosses in their vertical order; when a segment starts, ends, or two segments cross, only the segments that became adjacent in that order can newly intersect, so test just those and schedule any crossing found as a future event

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bentley–Ottmann algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry:

requires: an ordered set for the active segments
fails_when: degenerate inputs (shared endpoints, vertical segments) need special rules
